93cb69dd2b.why: The sign extension, product and accumulation are required, and the live counter update cannot absorb the comparison that supplies SF and OF.

08ada9ea6b.why: Both products and accumulators are live, and SSE4.1 cannot combine their arithmetic or the counter update and required comparison flags.

4c2292f093.why: Each of the three live vector destinations requires its copy, and the independent live counter requires zeroing.

cb00417786.why: All three full-width vector copies and the independent counter zeroing produce required final values.

01aabc5f50.why: SSE2 requires a transfer and shuffle for each scalar broadcast, while vector zeroing and the scalar scaling, pointer addition and negation are all required.

4e2e810691.why: Arbitrary multiplier, offset and unpack operands plus the live xmm1 result require both arithmetic paths, and SSE2 offers no shorter fused equivalent.

ce33a67bcd.why: Both SSE2 broadcasts require two instructions, and the vector zero, two pointer updates and scaled negative index are all live.

13c7f852dc.why: Both buffers require separate conversion paths with arbitrary coefficients and unpack operands, and the live xmm1 and xmm3 results prevent eliminating their intermediate computations.

c5a48bd303.why: Both GPR broadcasts require a transfer and duplication under SSE4.1, and the constant load, 32-bit scaling, pointer update and 64-bit negation remain necessary.

a4443d15f9.why: Both conversions need their full-width arithmetic and clamps, while the live shuffled xmm1 and xmm3 values prevent dropping the intermediate rearrangements.

9f99573094.why: Each SSE4.1 broadcast needs two instructions, and the three scalar operations preserve the required 32-bit shift truncation, pointer addition and 64-bit negation.

2d119906c5.why: Arbitrary inputs require both full-width multiply-add-shift paths, and the required shuffled xmm1 value prevents eliminating a final permutation.

eb8d3d2f07.why: The two broadcasts need separate transfers and duplications, and scaling, both pointer additions and the final 64-bit negation are required.

1fe78711ff.why: Both buffers and the live shuffled xmm1 and xmm3 results require all arithmetic paths and lane rearrangements under SSE4.1.

e39122d333.why: AVX2 cannot broadcast directly from these GPRs in one instruction, and the vector zeroing, 32-bit scaling, pointer update and 64-bit negation remain necessary.

5f42eb2fee.why: The arbitrary unpack, multiplier and offset operands and live full-width ymm1 result require both conversion paths, which already use three-operand AVX2 forms.

ae1da20fe5.why: Both AVX2 GPR broadcasts require a transfer and broadcast, and the constant load plus the scalar scaling, pointer addition and negation are all required.
